theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K ε : ℝ) (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (W : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → 0 < ε → ContDiff ℝ 1 W → (∀ x y : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ W x - fderiv ℝ W y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ W x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ∃ V : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) V ∧ (∀ x y : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ V x - fderiv ℝ V y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) ∧ (∀ x : Rn n, ‖fderiv ℝ V x - fderiv ℝ W x‖ ≤ K * ε ^ α) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ V x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0
